name: Cherokee
title: Cherokee Phoenix
intro: These words come from the Cherokee Phoenix (1828–1834), commonly described as the first Native American newspaper. It was printed in Sequoyah's syllabary. The box marks one word in a line. Pick the reading whose letters match the printed word. Highlighted letters are where the two readings differ, and the small pictures show how this paper printed them. You don't need to read Cherokee, only to match shapes. If the readings differ in more than one place, pick a reading only if all its highlighted letters match. Otherwise pick Neither.

notes.Ꮩ: this paper prints it as Λ, an A with no crossbar
